args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1), with an error rate of 0.18 across all production regions. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production.

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.

2. **Rolled back**: Deployed `v2.3.0` — the most recent release that was healthy in production — to all regions. Rollback confirmed (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident `INC-0002` for `checkout-api`, which paged the on-call engineer, describing the health-check failures and the rollback action taken.

transcript.content:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.

2. **Rolled back**: Deployed `v2.3.0` — the most recent release that was healthy in production — to all regions. Rollback confirmed (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident `INC-0002` for `checkout-api`, which paged the on-call engineer, describing the health-check failures and the rollback action taken.
